_comments: THE OUTBOUND DISPATCH JOB (#293). Every minute: a delivery is sent within a minute of becoming due, and a
checkout also kicks its own order's deliveries right after it completes, so a buyer does not wait for the clock.
Ships Active, unlike the renewal and billing jobs. Those write money and access; this one only sends what a
host's own registered consumer asked for, and with no consumer registered a pass claims nothing.
ConcurrencyMode Skip: two passes are safe anyway (each claims rows under a lease), but there is no gain in
overlapping them. MissedRunPolicy RunOnce: a backlog is one catch-up pass, capped by MaxCount.
OwnerUserID / NotifyUserID deliberately unset: they name people, which differs per environment.

fields.Name: Orders — Dispatch Outbound Events (every minute)
fields.Description: Sends due outbound events (order confirmations and entitlement grant changes) to their registered consumers, retrying failures with backoff and dead-lettering them after their deadline.
